Describe the user-visible problem and result. Link an issue if one exists.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test` (synthetic data only)
- [ ] `npm run check:public`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] No private mail, credentials, real inbox identifiers, or production screenshots included

Mention skipped checks and why. For UI changes, include synthetic desktop/mobile screenshots when useful. For dependency changes, include `npm audit` results. Disclose any changes to authentication, mail rendering, sending, provider access, or CI permissions.
